(1) interface command: OCaml ClassInfo entries for `module_definition` now serialize kind:"module" and `type_definition` now serialize kind:"type" (previously the kind field was omitted / None). notes: OCaml has no class axis in extract (Language::Ocaml => {} // No classes), so there is no extract.rs ClassInfo.kind arm to populate for OCaml; the structure definitions[] path (collect_definitions) already used the structural ocaml_value_definition_is_function from Stage 2. The two remaining params-only mis-classifiers were extract_ocaml_functions (structure functions[] / impact / chunker) -- now fixed -- and the interface module/type kind gap -- now fixed. diff.rs uses its own already-structural ocaml_let_binding_is_function (no change needed). The single non-green test (javascript_prototype_assignments_emitted) is pre-existing and JS-only, verified failing on a clean HEAD worktree.
